title: Color sequence memory game
when: The user wants the game where colored pads light up in a growing sequence and the player repeats it.
prompt:
Goal: A sequence game with distinct tones, numbers as a second cue and a pace that ramps up.
Steps:
1. 4 pads as buttons labeled 1 to 4 and by color, each with a tone (329, 261, 220, 164 Hz) from Web Audio; AudioContext made on Start.
2. logic.mjs: extend(seq, rand), check(seq, inputs) returning continue, roundDone or fail, interval(round) from 600 ms down to 300 ms by round 13.
3. Playback locks input and lights each pad for 60 percent of the interval; then waits for the player.
4. Keys 1 to 4 press pads; the lit state changes brightness and outline, not only hue.
5. Strict mode restarts on a mistake; normal mode replays the sequence.
6. Round and best in aria-live and localStorage guarded; reduced motion removes scaling, keeps the light.
7. test.mjs: check states, extend grows by one, interval curve.
Quality bar:
- Each pad identifiable by number, color and tone.
- Clear "Your turn" cue.
- Pads at least 100 px on phones.
Pitfalls:
- Accepting input during playback.
- Overlapping tones from stacked oscillators.
- Red and green as the only difference.
Verify:
- [ ] Pads labeled.
- [ ] Status live.
- [ ] Reduced motion rule present.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js (audio and playback), logic.mjs, test.mjs.

examples.input: jogo de memoria de sequencia de cores
examples.output: 4 pads with tones, round 7, strict mode toggle, best 12
